title: Split-KV decode attention
brief: Merge partial softmax results with the log-sum-exp, choose a split count from the SM count, and run a split decode kernel when CUDA is available.
hints: Weight each partial output by exp(lse_i - lse) before adding. A mean of the partial outputs ignores how much softmax mass each chunk holds.
An empty chunk stores a log-sum-exp of negative infinity. exp(-inf) is zero, so that chunk adds nothing.
Return 1 when batch times heads covers at least 80% of num_sms. That includes every case where batch times heads is at least num_sms.
Cap the split count by ceil(kv_len / 64). A longer cache can add a split. It does not remove one.
